tūla: [Tūla=tula+a] (ti) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 494. Nīti, dhā. 164. Dhātvattha. 170. In Thī tūlinī](1) Silk cotton, Cotton, (A) A silk cotton tree (such as Red silk cotton tree Salmalia Malabarica). (B) A creeper (the root of which is edible Pueraria ruberosa). (C) Grass (A kind of long and bladed grass whose roots have medicinal value, etc.,). (D) Fur. (E) Clothing. (F) Plant fiber. (G) Grass. (H) Leaves. See - Tūlagaṇana. (2) A mattress filled with silk cotton. See - Tūlasannibha-(2). (3) Tūlonaddha Vinaya. (4) It is like silk cotton.
tūlabhisi: [Tūla+bhisi] (thī) CL=7 A mattress filled with silk cotton.
tūlabibbohana: [Tūla+bimbo(bbo)hana] (na,thī) CL=7 A pillow filled with silk cotton, A silk cotton pillow.
tūlabimbohana: [Tūla+bimbo(bbo)hana] (na,thī) CL=7 A pillow filled with silk cotton, A silk cotton pillow.
tūlagaṇana: [Tūla+gaṇana] (na,thī) CL=7 There are five kinds of cotton, A mattress can be filled with five kinds, they are fur, pieces of clothing, plant fiber, grass, and leaves. See also - Bhisi.
tūlaphassa: [Tūla+phassa] (pu) CL=7 The touch of silk cotton. See - Tūlaphassasadisa.
tūlaphassasadisa: [Tūlaphassa+sadisa] (ti) CL=7 (Grass, etc.,) that is like the touch of silk cotton. See - Tūlaphassasamūpama.
tūlaphassasamūpama: [Tūlaphassa+samūpamā] (ti) CL=7 It is similar to the touch of silk cotton that is (grass, etc.,).
tūlapicupūrita: [Tūlapicu+pūrita] (ti) CL=7 (Pillow, Mattress, etc.,) that is filled with silk cotton.
tūlapicusama: [Tūlapicu+sama] (ti) CL=7 It looks like silk cotton.
tūlapicusamphassa: [Tūlapicu+samphassa] (pu) CL=7 Touching sense of silk cotton.
tūlapuṇṇa: [Tūla+puṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 (Pillow, Mattress, etc.,) that filled with silk cotton.
tūlapūrita: [Tūla+pūrita] (ti) CL=7 (Pillow, Mattress, etc.,) that is filled with silk cotton.
tūlasannibha: [Tūla+sannibha] (ti) CL=7 (1) It is like silk cotton, It is pure white like silk cotton (that is a single hair that grows between Buddha"s eyebrows, etc.,). (2) (A Bedsheet) which is soft like softness of silk cotton.
tūlasāṭakayuga: [Thūlasāṭaka+yuga] (na) CL=7 It is rough and thick a set of the lower garment of a man, A Rough lower garment (of a man).
tūlattaya: [Tūla+taya] (na) CL=7 The three kinds of cotton, There are three kinds of cotton they are creeper, grass, and silk cotton.
tūlikagga: [Tūlikā+agga] (na) CL=7 A tip of a paintbrush, A tip of a nip of a pen.
tūlikasadisa: [Tūlikā+sadisa] (ti) CL=7 It looks like a silk cotton mattress, (A Bedsheet, etc.,) that is soft like a silk cotton mattress. See - Tūlasannabha-(2).
tūlikā: [Tūla+ṇika+ā] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A mattress) which is filled with a kind of material that plants (fiber), creeper (fiber), grass (fiber), and silk cotton. (2) A paintbrush, Pen. See - Tūlikagga.
tūlikāvikatiyuta: [Tūlikā+vikati+yuta] (ti) CL=7 (A Bed, etc.,) which is made of a silk cotton mattress with a mysterious bedsheet (on which paint a lion figure, etc.,).
tūlonaddha: [Tūla+onaddha] (ti) CL=7 (A) It is made of a kind of material that plants (fiber), creepers (fiber) and grass, and silk cotton. (B) (A bedstead, et.,) that weaves (makes) a kind of material that plants, creeper, grass, and silk cotton.
tūlonaddhasikkhāpada: [Tūlonaddha+sikkhāpada] (na) CL=7 Tūlonaddha Vinaya, Order a rule of conduct of Buddhist order due to a Chabbaggī Bhikkhu who orders someone to make a bedstead for him which is made with a kind of material that plant, creeper, grass, and silk cotton.
tūlī: [Tūla+ī] (ti) CL=7 (A mattress) which is filled with a kind of material that plants, creepers, grass, and silk cotton.
tūlūpanibha: [Tūla+upanibhā] (ti) CL=7 It is like silk cotton, It is soft like silk cotton.
tūra: [Tūra+a] (na) CL=7 [Tūra and tūriya-saddā each other make deception. (nīti, sutta. 539. Moga, 4. 122 - sya See).] The equipment (or) Tools (or) instrument.
tūriya: [Tū(tu)ra+ṇya] (na) CL=7 [Thoma. Pītīakaca. ] (1) The instrument. (2) Sound of musical instruments. See - Tūriyasannissita.
tūriyagaṇa: [Tūriya+gaṇa] (pu) CL=7 All five kinds of instruments.
tūriyahattha: [Tūriya+hattha] (ti) CL=7 One who holds the instrument.
tūriyanigghosa: [Tūriya+nigghosa] (pu) CL=7 The sound of playing a musical instrument.
tūriyantara: [Tūriya+antara] (na) CL=7 The special instrument (such as Oboe, Flute, and Conch shell).
tūriyarava: [Tūriya+rava] (pu) CL=7 The sound of playing musical instruments.
tūriyasadda: [Tūriya+sadda] (pu) CL=7 Music (or) Sound of playing a musical instrument.
tūriyasannissita: [Tūriya+sannissita] (ti) CL=7 It depends on the musical instruments.
tūriyasatasahassa: [Tūriya+satasahassa] (na) CL=7 A hundred thousand musical instruments.
tūriyasaṅghuṭṭha: [Tū(tu)riya+saṅghuṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 It produces sound by playing five kinds of musical instruments, It has five kinds of musical instruments that should be played.
tūriyatāḷa: [Tūriya+tāḷa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Playing the musical instrument. (Ti) (2) The sound of playing musical instruments. See - Tūriyatāḷasaṅghuṭtha.
tūriyatāḷasaṅghuṭṭha: [Tūriyatāḷa+saṅghuṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 (1) It shouts by playing a musical instrument. (2) (Garden, etc.,) which is the place for shouting and playing musical instruments.
tūriyatāḷita: [Tūriya+tāḷita] (na) CL=7 (1) Playing the musical instrument. See - Tūriyatāḷitasaṅghuṭṭha. (Ti) (2) The instrument should be played. See - Tūriyatāḷitanigghosa.
tūriyatāḷitanigghosa: [Tūriyatāḷita+nigghosa] (pu) CL=7 (1) The sound of a percussion instrument. (Ti) (2) One who is playing a musical instrument.
tūriyatāḷitasaṅghuṭṭha: [Tūriyatāḷita+saṅghuṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 One who is singing and playing a musical instrument, A musician.
tūriyatāḷitavādita: [Tūriya+tāḷita+vādita] (na) CL=7 (1) Firstly playing a musical instrument (and) later playing a musical instrument. (2) Beating the (big drum, etc.,) (and) playing the musical instruments (harp, etc.,).
tūriyatāḷitavāditanigghosasadda: [Tūriya+tāḷita+vādita+nigghosasadda] (pu) CL=7 The sound of beating the (big drum, etc.,) (and) playing the musical instruments (harp, etc.,).
tūriyavādaka: [Tūriya+vādaka] (ti) CL=7 One who plays musical instruments, A musician.
tūriyaṅga: [Tūriya+aṅga] (na) CL=7 The "parts" of five instruments (that is one or two kinds of musical instruments, etc.,). (1)  Ātata drum is an open-ended drum with a long body, etc., (2) Vitata drum is a small drum with tapering ends. (3) Ātatavitata drum is a two-headed drum flared at both ends. (4) Susira is Oboe, flute, etc., (5) Ghana drum is a combination of five kinds of instruments such as Gong, Brass gong. All of those are called musical instruments. See original.
tūyarigaṇappabodhana: [Tūriyagaṇa+pabodhana] (ti) CL=7 It wakes up clear and fresh due to the sound of playing musical instruments, One who freshly wakes up due to all of musical instruments.
tūṇa: [Tūṇa+a] (pu) CL=7 [In Thī tūṇā, tūṇī] A Quiver, A quiver is (a container for holding arrows).
tūṇayati: [Tūṇa+ṇaya+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 It fills up. See - Tūṇa.
tūṇenti: [Tūṇa+ṇe+anti] (kā,kri) CL=7 It makes them fulfilled. See - Tūṇa.
tūṇeti: [Tūṇa+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 It fills up. See - Tūṇa.
tūṇira: [Tū(tu)ṇa+i(ī)-ra] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna. Dhāna, ṭī. 389, 863. Tuṇa+ra. I-āguṃ. Tuṇiranti sarakalāpaṃ. Sohi tuṇati hiṃ sati etenāti tuṇiroti vuccati. Tuṇa hiṃsāyanti muddhajapañcamakkharantadhātuto ra-paccayavasena padasiddhi veditabbā. Jā, ṭī, 17. 522.] A quiver, which is a container for holding arrows.
tūṇironaddhacammasaṇṭhāna: [Tūṇi(ṇī)-ronaddha+camma+saṇṭhāna]  CL=9 The skin formation (like on arms etc.) that can be tied/bound like a quiver and arrows.
tūṇīra: [Tū(tu)ṇa+i(ī)-ra] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna. Dhāna, ṭī. 389, 863. Tuṇa+ra. I-āguṃ. Tuṇiranti sarakalāpaṃ. Sohi tuṇati hiṃ sati etenāti tuṇiroti vuccati. Tuṇa hiṃsāyanti muddhajapañcamakkharantadhātuto ra-paccayavasena padasiddhi veditabbā. Jā, ṭī, 17. 522.] A quiver, Which is a container for holding arrows.
tūṇīronaddhacammasaṇṭhāna: [Tūṇi(ṇī)-ronaddha+camma+saṇṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 (Arm"s skin, etc.,) which is a leather that wraps on a quiver.
